package: W67-01 — local OS-managed settings directory discovery
question: Does the product read a locally deployed managed policy when no explicit policy file is given, with the source file-tier order and merge rules?
answer: Yes: the platform managed-settings.json and non-hidden drop-ins are read in the source order, merged with the source customizer, projected onto the four carried policy keys, and reported; explicit-file strictness and managed-over-authored precedence are unchanged.

behavior.discovery: options.managedSettingsFile wins; otherwise options.managedSettingsDir (test/caller seam where source Oko is dead) or managedSettingsDir()
behavior.order: managed-settings.json, then managed-settings.d names sorted ascending
behavior.filter: regular file or symlink, name ends .json, name does not start with "."
behavior.merge: mergeSettings(merged, document) — the source MB(..., Y3)
behavior.ignored: other keys are dropped and reported once per key
behavior.errors: missing directory/file is absence; unreadable, invalid JSON or non-object documents and schema-rejected merges are reported and contribute no policy
behavior.explicitFile: unchanged strict path: unknown keys and schema errors throw

changes.change: managedSettingsDir option, loadManagedSettingsDirectory, report type, discovery wiring
three C-5 rows record the local file tier

added: the OS-managed directory merges its base file and sorted drop-ins
a missing managed directory is absence and a broken document contributes nothing

residuals: Remote/account managed policy is excluded by the local-only directive.
The plist and Windows registry tiers, WSL inheritance (Eut) and the policy-helper flag protocol are not ported.
Substitution values (onlySubstitutes / Nd floors), document-link bookkeeping and the loadState enum are not ported.
Managed files must be strict JSON; comments are rejected and reported.
Keys outside the four carried policy keys are reported and dropped, not enforced.
The full original approval flow and recursive configuration discovery remain C-5 work.
The identity first recorded in this file (b1c74f0c…) was measured before the final build; W68-01 corrects it to f8c89d5a… for the committed tree.
next: C-5 continues with the approval flow and recursive discovery; remote policy stays excluded.
